scripts.cdk:synth:dev: export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk synth -c environment=dev
scripts.cdk:synth:prod: export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk synth -c environment=prod
scripts.cdk:deploy:dev: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://dev-api.homechrome.in NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://dev-store.homechrome.in npx @opennextjs/aws build && export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk deploy --all --require-approval never -c environment=dev && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name HomechromeStoreStack-dev --region ap-south-1 --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='DistributionId'].OutputValue" --output text) --paths '/*'
scripts.cdk:deploy:prod: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.homechrome.in NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://homechrome.in npx @opennextjs/aws build && export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk deploy --all --require-approval never -c environment=prod && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name HomechromeStoreStack-prod --region ap-south-1 --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='DistributionId'].OutputValue" --output text) --paths '/*'
scripts.cdk:destroy:dev: export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk destroy --all -c environment=dev
scripts.cdk:destroy:prod: export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk destroy --all -c environment=prod
